description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. The payer of a stalled, expensive parcel asks for a refund.

messages.subject: Floor basket stuck in transit
messages.body: My floor basket, order KIK-1029, has been sitting at the Mombasa depot for well over a week. I'd like a refund rather than waiting any longer.
